sentences.text: The Satptc scheme is designed to provide financial assistance to the families of deceased government employees.
The objective of the scheme is to support the families during their time of need after the loss of the primary breadwinner.
The benefits include a one-time financial assistance amount that is provided to the eligible family members.
Eligibility is generally limited to the families of government employees who have died while in service.
The application process typically involves submitting a request along with necessary documentation to the relevant government department.
The timeline for disbursement of funds may vary based on the processing of applications.
The implementing authority for the Satptc scheme is usually the respective state government or the central government department responsible for employee welfare.
Additional details about the specific amount of assistance and required documentation may vary by state or department.
